ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Mobile is entered in correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) , NOT REGEX( MobilePhone , "^\\+?614[0-9]{8}+$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Mobile Number in +61412345678 format.
